changelog: Security: Fixed shell argument injection in DatabaseController createMySQLUser
Security: Hardened FileManagerController against multi-dot recursive path traversal
Security: Hardened Webmail HTML body sanitizer against unquoted and URI XSS evasion
Security: Added strict supported version allowlist validation in PhpController service management
Security: Hardened default .env permissions and enabled Nginx TLS 1.2+ minimum protocols
Security: Updated installer to Node.js 22 LTS, Fail2ban pre-configuration, and PHP version masking
Security: Hardened Nginx site templates with server_tokens off, X-Powered-By hiding, and database/backup file blocking
Fix: Switched nimbus-nginx.conf to universal local SSL certificates and added port 2095 HTTP to HTTPS redirect
Fix: Resolved 403 Access Denied when opening domain File Manager from WordPress or Domains
Fix: Declared missing supportedVersions property in PhpController for PHP-FPM restart
commands: sudo cp /usr/local/nimbus/scripts/n /usr/local/bin/n 2>/dev/null && sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/n 2>/dev/null && sudo ln -sf /usr/local/bin/n /usr/bin/n 2>/dev/null || true
